fieldValues.title: srs-rust#1535: an ask filed as unplaced where the compass placed it; the clear-mode case reached the owner's desk as a question
fieldValues.summary: The builder's ask A1 ("Where should the fieldMeta.source check live?") carried why_unplaced: "an implementation-layer choice", and clerk pr-check passed it. The compass case written on 2026-11-03 settles it in one table: cell Conformance, decision mode clear, Door 1, option B (schema validation on the write path) passes every test. By rfc-decision-7caca3a1 and pr-decisions that is a ruling the group records and cites, and the PR is agent-mergeable; instead it sat on the owner's desk as "Decision asked" (row 7, 2026-11-03).
evidence: srs-rust#1535 body, srs-decisions block: asks[0].why_unplaced, no compass cell, no tension
clerk pr-check srs-rust#1535, 2026-11-03: "ok: every decision is in the block, classed and placed"
the compass case (owner's session, 2026-11-03 afternoon): tests One home, One way over many, Reliability over Renewal (axis 5-11), Identifier over label, Spec-first; cell Conformance; mode clear
clerk desk 2026-11-03 10:15: "Decision asked in srs-rust#1535 ... It waits on your answer"
fieldValues.body: The stop is at Settle by principle: the compass was not consulted where the ask was written, and why_unplaced is an escape with no test (finding b326b3fb said the fractal compass has the structure but no check). The same shape is on the desk for srs-rust#1549. Remedy filed as clerk#269: compass first in pr-check; an ask the compass settles is an error with the instruction to record a ruling.
